fullPassage: Reformist approaches assume that markets could operate in more equitable and environmentally reasonable ways, and that a market is the most efficient option available. Yet the logic of market efficiencies generally rotates on purely monetary calculations, effectively reasoning in a hall of mirrors and marginalising real social and environmental values. Familiar examples are conventional food retailers, such as supermarkets, which purchase fruit and vegetables as cheaply as possible. Inexpensive produce might be grown using soil- and water-damaging fertilisers, by poorly paid illegal migrant workers, and transported long distances using more cheap labour and environmentally damaging practices. However, organic farmers can only follow ecologically sound practices and make sure they pay their workers fair wages if the food costs more, meaning supply for an elite demand. By its very nature, one never manages to escape the conundrums that production for trade entails. Real social and environmental values involved in caring for people and Earth highlighting the inequities and damage of market-oriented activities.

det.korean: 명확한 답이나 해결책이 없는 어려운 문제 = conundrum(난제)
det.analysis:
✅ ① conundrum: '난제'는 명확한 답이 없는 어려운 문제라는 정의와 일치 ←정답
❌ ② efficiency: '효율성'은 어려운 문제가 아니라 자원 활용의 정도
❌ ③ retailer: '소매업체'는 문제가 아니라 상업 주체
❌ ④ calculation: '계산'은 답을 구하는 과정이지 풀 수 없는 문제가 아님

questions.passage: Yet the logic of market efficiencies generally rotates on purely monetary calculations, __________ (effect) reasoning in a hall of mirrors and marginalising real social and environmental values.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 분사구문 reasoning을 수식하는 부사가 필요. 명사 effect를 부사 effectively로 변환. 'effectively reasoning in a hall of mirrors'(사실상 거울의 방에서 추론하며)
det.tip: 부사 위치: 분사(reasoning) 앞에서 수식 → effectively

det.analysis: 형용사 reasonable을 수식하는 부사가 필요. 명사 environment를 부사 environmentally로 변환. 'environmentally reasonable ways'(환경적으로 합리적인 방식)

overlay.excerptSentences: Reformist approaches assume that markets could operate in more equitable and __________ (environment) reasonable ways, and that a market is the most efficient option available.

questions.passage: Reformist approaches assume that markets could operate in more equitable and environmentally reasonable ways, and that a market is the most efficient option available. Yet the logic of market efficiencies generally rotates on purely monetary calculations, effectively reasoning in a hall of mirrors and marginalising real social and environmental values. Familiar examples are conventional food retailers, such as supermarkets, which purchase fruit and vegetables as cheaply as possible. Inexpensive produce might be grown using soil- and water-damaging fertilisers, by poorly paid illegal migrant workers, and transported long distances using more cheap labour and environmentally damaging practices. However, __________ can only follow ecologically sound practices and make sure they pay their workers fair wages if the food costs more, meaning supply for an elite demand. By its very nature, one never manages to escape the conundrums that production for trade entails. Real social and environmental values involved in caring for people and Earth highlighting the inequities and damage of market-oriented activities.

det.korean: ____는 생태학적으로 건전한 관행을 따르고 근로자에게 공정한 임금을 보장할 수 있다
det.analysis:
❌ ① conventional retailers: '전통적 소매업체'는 싸게 구매하는 주체이며 생태적 관행과 대비됨
❌ ② migrant workers: '이주 노동자'는 저임금 노동의 대상이지 관행을 따르는 주체가 아님
✅ ③ organic farmers: '유기농 농부'는 생태적 관행을 따르고 공정 임금을 보장하는 주체로 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ market efficiencies: '시장 효율성'은 추상 개념이지 관행을 따르는 주체가 아님

det.korean: 유기농 식품이 더 비싸야 하므로, 이는 ____을 의미한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① demand for cheaper produce: '더 저렴한 농산물 수요'는 유기농 식품이 비싸다는 맥락과 모순
❌ ② equal access for all consumers: '모든 소비자의 동등한 접근'은 엘리트 수요라는 원문의 제한적 공급과 반대
❌ ③ profit for conventional retailers: '전통적 소매업체의 이익'은 유기농 농부의 비용 문제와 관련 없음
✅ ④ supply for an elite demand: '엘리트 수요를 위한 공급'은 비싼 유기농 식품이 소수만 소비할 수 있다는 원문과 일치 ←정답
det.tip: supply for an elite demand = 엘리트/상류층 수요를 위한 공급
